summary: Lewis Hamilton faces redemption in Austin after his Singapore strategy blunder handed momentum to runaway championship leader Kimi Antonelli, who stands on the brink of clinching the world title at Circuit of the Americas. Ferrari's tactical precision will be tested against McLaren's raw pace advantage, with Carlos Sainz and Oscar Piastri ready to exploit any misstep from the Antonelli camp. A victory for Antonelli would seal the crown and crown the youngest champion in F1 history, while any slip-up could resurrect the championship battle with races still remaining.
